messages:
maria: Quick pass on the Compliance > Data residency screen. Not huge, but several UX/accessibility nits we should clean up before release. Fig link: https://www.figma.com/file/aaaa/Compliance-Residency
devon: Thanks — can you enumerate? I can grab the small frontend bits.
tess: Also copy/security checks I can review.
maria: 1) Labeling: current label reads "Data lifetime" which felt vague in user tests. Suggested alternatives: "Retention length" or "How long data is kept". Prefer conversational copy for non-admins.
kevin: +1 for conversational. Legal asked for explicit "retention" wording somewhere on the row so external auditors can find it.
2) Toggle behavior: when switching to "Indefinite" the days input stays visible and accepts numbers. Users clicked it and wondered if Indefinite applied. Recommend hiding the numeric box and showing a small status pill "Kept indefinitely" with a hover tooltip that explains implications.
devon: Implementation note: hiding UI instead of disabling is safer for screen reader clarity so it doesn't read "disabled input". We can set aria-hidden on the numeric input and expose the pill in DOM.
samuel: For that case make sure to add aria-live region to announce "Retention set to indefinite" when user toggles, because some assistive tech won't pick up visual-only changes.
3) Region ordering: the dropdown lists regions by internal zone code (e.g., eu-west-2 first). Product asked to reorder by user impact: most-used regions first, then alphabetical fallback. Also have a "Recommended" badge for org-preferred region.
tess: Can we show small hint text under the dropdown: "Choosing region affects where data is stored and could affect latency"? Make it programmatically linked with aria-describedby.
4) KMS badge copy: current: "Customer key". Suggest: "Managed by customer (BYOK)" and include a short help link "What is BYOK?" that opens the key drawer. Security approves.
kevin: Also include a machine-readable attribute like data-key-status="byok" for telemetry and easier e2e tests.
5) Key details drawer: when opened, the drawer lists Key ID, created on, last rotated, and rotation schedule. Keep headings terse and semantic (Key ID as heading + readable id). Also add a small action "Rotate key" disabled unless org has rotation permissions.
devon: Accessibility: when drawer opens move focus to its first heading and trap focus. Add role=dialog and aria-modal. We'll add a visually hidden link "Close drawer" for keyboard users.
samuel: Audit log copy: timestamps should include "UTC" label (e.g., 2026-02-10 09:12 UTC) and exports (CSV) should have a header "timestamp_utc" to avoid confusion during legal export. Policy team asks we keep format consistent across UI and export.
policy-bot: [policy] Confirmed: retention export format must use UTC and the header "timestamp_utc". See spec /policies/retention/export-format-v2.
maria: Good. Also note export filenames currently include local tz, please standardize to "audit-log-YYYYMMDD-UTC.csv".
tess: Small microcopy: change the audit log filter placeholder from "search..." to "Filter events by user, action, or resource" — helps power users.
devon: One keyboard flow bug I hit: opening the region dropdown with keyboard then hitting Escape closes the dropdown but focus stays on an off-screen helper element. I can reproduce and will include steps in the ticket.
maria: Ok next steps: tess to finalize the exact copy for labels and placeholders, samuel to write the a11y acceptance tests, devon to create frontend ticket with reproduction steps + aria changes, kevin to add telemetry attribute and confirm security phrasing. I'll coordinate QA once these land.
tess: I'll post the copy edits and updated figma frame by EOD.
devon: Ticket ETA: tomorrow morning, will link here.
kevin: Will validate BYOK wording with security and post final string.
policy-bot: [reminder] Compliance review scheduled Fri 9:00 PT. Please bring final copy and accessibility checklist.
maria: Thanks all — tagging: @samuel for a11y signoff, @kevin for security wording, @devon for implementation. :white_check_mark:
